business_problem: FLOA's prospects and customers seek support across web, phone, and app; recurring requests also occupy advisors who could devote more time to complex situations.
solution_summary: EVA is FLOA’s conversational platform, developed to support prospects and customers throughout their journey. It is accessible from the FLOA website, by phone, and in the FLOA app, providing a consistent 24/7 entry point. The platform combines generative AI with FLOA’s business expertise to provide quick, contextualized answers, direct users to the digital service matching their request, and process some requests. The source does not identify the underlying models, data sources, processing or storage services, or technical integrations; those implementation details therefore remain unspecified. Customers may request an advisor at any time, and human intervention is systematic for complex transactions. EVA thus augments FLOA’s customer-support operation rather than replacing human expertise. The page describes the service channels and customer/advisor interaction but does not explain how conversation data is stored or analyzed.

evidence_quotes: EVA is the intelligent conversational platform developed by FLOA to support our prospects and customers at every stage of their journey.
Accessible from our website, by phone and in the FLOA app, it offers them a consistent experience, regardless of the channel used.
Thanks to FLOA's generative artificial intelligence and business expertise, EVA provides quick and contextualised answers.
To date, 78% of customer contacts handled by EVA are managed automatically by the platform.
Its Net Promoter Score, or NPS, now stands at +44, based on nearly 15,000 responses
